exposure: Neonates needing advanced resuscitation after birth
Neonates delivered by assisted vaginal delivery
outcome: Cord blood Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (CBTSH) level
cohort: 979 neonates born at a tertiary care referral center
finding: Mode of delivery and perinatal stress factors significantly influence CBTSH levels, and a cutoff level of CBTSH >16.10 μIU/mL is a practical screening tool for CH in this setting.
mod_finding: CBTSH levels were significantly higher in neonates delivered by assisted vaginal delivery and normal delivery compared to other modes of delivery.
